title: Kritt-ai/open-kritt
claim: Kritt-ai/open-kritt — Orchestrate AI agents to find real vulnerabilities in code.
why_good: Points multiple agents at code to find real vulnerabilities — AI-native AppSec is a large, high-budget market with clear ROI.
value: Sell to security/eng teams as a scanner + triage service; per-repo/seat or usage, a budget line security orgs already have.
risk: Crowded and trust-heavy (Snyk, Semgrep, GitHub); agent-found vulns need low false-positives and proof to be trusted.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product for automating vulnerability detection, which companies would pay for.

zh.claim: Kritt-ai/open-kritt —— 编排 AI agent 去代码里找真实漏洞。
zh.why_good: 用多个 agent 扫代码找真实漏洞——AI 原生的应用安全是个大、高预算、ROI 清晰的市场。
zh.value: 卖给安全/工程团队做扫描 + 分诊服务;按仓库/席位或按量,安全组织本就有这笔预算。
zh.risk: 拥挤且重信任(Snyk、Semgrep、GitHub);agent 找到的漏洞要低误报 + 有证据才被信任。
